verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a public REST API secured by API keys (activepieces-docs-2, activepieces-docs-28, activepieces-docs-33) and an MCP server that lets AI assistants build flows via natural language (activepieces-docs-4, activepieces-docs-27), suggesting some programmatic flow management exists. However, there is no explicit evidence of REST endpoints for creating, updating, and activating a flow, and probes for an OpenAPI/swagger spec all 404 (activepieces-probe-3), leaving the exact API surface unverified. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of flow create/update/activate endpoints, a working OpenAPI spec, and independent confirmation of programmatic flow lifecycle control.
